evidence.claim: Xenoverse 2 Character ID List assigns skill ID 542 to Tricky Strike, marks it CaC-unavailable, and identifies Demon God Demigra (Final Form) as its source.
A Xenoverse 2 skill-list artifact places Tricky Strike in the Super Skills section and identifies it as skill ID 542.
Legend Patrol's Defend History! Unknown Battle lists Tricky Strike on Final Form Demigra.
Xenoverse 2 Demigra reference material describes Tricky Strike as a multi-variant teleporting attack with Teleporting Uppercut, Teleporting Punch, and Boiling Breath variants.
A Xenoverse 2 catalog of skills unobtainable by CaC lists Tricky Strike.

resolved_fields.attack_description: A multi-variant teleporting attack that can produce an uppercut, explosive punch, or Boiling Breath-style blue energy cloud depending on the selected variant.
